title: showcase.json
description: Facts about one project that a portfolio can show. Importance and ordering belong to the portfolio, not here.

pitch.description: One sentence that makes someone want to click.

kind.description: local-web-app: a browser UI backed by a process on the user's machine (local models, hardware, files), so it cannot be hosted as-is.

live.description: One click to try it for real: a hosted demo, browser terminal, store listing, playground or replay.

hero.description: Still image, path relative to the project root or a URL.

motion.description: Short silent loop (animated WebP or GIF).

video.description: Longer video, may have sound (MP4 or WebM).

capture.description: Command that regenerates the media from scratch.

local.description: One command that runs a seeded demo locally.

ceiling.description: Highest tier this project can realistically reach, e.g. A when it cannot be hosted.
